metadata.title: Validate Step Structure
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Perform comprehensive validation of a step file. Use after creating step files to ensure compliance.

output.description: Comprehensive validation report with pass/fail status

prerequisites: Both MD and JSON files present
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: read step → self-contained check → section check → diagram check → guidance check → naming check → report
Self-contained means: no @framework-step references, step is complete and standalone
Section completeness: MD has user docs + flow, JSON has guidance + substeps
Naming compliance: kebab-case filename, proper title format

update: memory.json (current step section with validation results)

tools: read_file - Read step MD and JSON files
grep - Search for patterns and references
bestPractices: Check both MD and JSON files
Verify no @framework-step references in step content
Verify guidance is specific and actionable

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Read step file
substeps.description: Load both MD and JSON files for validation

substeps.name: Self-contained check
substeps.description: Verify step has no external step references
actions: Verify step doesn't depend on other steps
Mark as pass if self-contained, fail if references found

substeps.name: Section completeness check
substeps.description: Verify all required sections are present
actions: MD file should have: Description, Purpose & Usage, Quick Reference, Flow
JSON file should have: metadata, output, guidance, substeps, flow, memoryFileUsage, dependencies

substeps.name: Validate mermaid diagram
substeps.description: Check flow diagram syntax and completeness
actions: Verify mermaid flowchart syntax is valid

substeps.name: Check guidance quality
substeps.description: Ensure guidance is detailed and actionable

substeps.name: Create validation report
substeps.description: Compile all check results into report
actions: List specific issues found with suggested fixes

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Verify: Do modified process files conform to type definitions? (Principle 7 - see `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md`)
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Linear flow: read step → self-contained check → section check → diagram check → guidance check → naming check → create report

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Step file path from previous step or parameters
fields: Information Produced: Validation results, issues found, pass/fail status
Decisions Made: Required fixes if validation failed
